about: Where the town's bicycles stand at a new game (docs/bikes.md). bikes: free-standing ones, at [x, y] in Unreal metres (the ground is found under it), yaw in degrees, on the kickstand (or lean: degrees against a wall, + to its right). entrances: one bike in the lobby of each stair (people_places.json stairs), against the lobby's nearer wall, belonging to a household living up that stair (PeopleSim AssignBikes). paint: index into paints (sRGB 0..255).
